      "snippet": "Got it. This is a straightforward permissions + location issue, not a script bug.
On Termux/Android, scripts under /storage/emulated/0 cannot be executed directly (noexec mount). That’s why you’re getting Permission denied even after chmod +x.
You have two correct options. Use Option A (fastest).

✅ OPTION A (RECOMMENDED): Run with bash explicitly
You do not need execute permission.
Run this:
bashCopy codebash mb_observe_teaching_harvest.sh

or, if it lives under /storage/emulated/0/...:
bashCop"
